project.description: A royal registry that turns a developer's role and experience into a digital noble title, coat of arms, and epic proclamation.

lore.kingdom: The Kingdom of a Thousand Algorithms
lore.intro: In the digital age, when realms crumble under compile errors and old architectures fade, one fellowship remains. Its members wield logic as others wield swords, inscribe oaths in lines of code, and raise citadels time cannot easily destroy. Present yourself before the Grand Registry: declare your craft, reveal the years devoted to it, and let the guild proclaim the rank you are owed.
lore.closing: May your code stay robust, your deploys victorious, and production bugs spare your nights.

evaluation.rankingNote: In this playful version, years of experience determine rank. Role personalizes title, feats, and proclamation. Seniority alone is not a measure of real skill.

role.label: Which craft do you practice in the realm?

frontend.label: Frontend Developer
frontend.description: Architect of interfaces and guardian of user experience.

backend.description: Master of invisible mechanisms, data, and the realm's inner workings.

mobile.description: Crafts portable artifacts that follow travelers everywhere.

software_engineer.description: Engineer of systems and builder of lasting solutions.

data_engineer.description: Keeper of data rivers and the kingdom's archives.

ai_engineer.description: Invoker of artificial minds and explorer of knowledge's frontiers.

game_developer.label: Game Developer

yearsOfExperience.label: How many years have you devoted to this craft?
yearsOfExperience.helpText: Count real development experience — not the number of languages installed on your machine.

rankRules.invalidInputMessage: The Grand Registry does not recognize this duration. Enter a whole number between 0 and 80.
rankRules.rankNotFoundMessage: The royal scribe found no rank matching your path.

resultTemplate.heading: The realm recognizes your name
resultTemplate.mottoLabel: Motto of your coat of arms
resultTemplate.shareTextTemplate: By the guild's great seal, I am recognized as {ceremonialTitle} after {yearsOfExperience} year(s) devoted to the craft of code. My motto: « {mottoTranslation} » May the digital chronicles remember my passage! #TheHustleTranslator #DevelopersDay
resultTemplate.footer: Titles are symbolic. True nobility in code is also measured by what you build, learn, and pass on.

squire-of-code.name: Squire of the First Lines
squire-of-code.mottoTranslation: Every work begins with a first line.
squire-of-code.proclamation: Hear ye, people of the Kingdom of a Thousand Algorithms! The guild bells ring for a new aspirant to the coding arts — a Squire of the First Lines, standing at the threshold of a vast realm yet to be mapped. May errors teach patience, documentation reveal its secrets, and every function become a stone in the foundation of a greater future.

May mistakes be witnesses of learning, not shame, and may ambition never outgrow the will to understand.
